Slop Tables · free, in your browser

A free Excel alternative in your browser

For budgets, lists and everyday sums, Slop Tables gives you a grid, formulas and Excel files in a browser tab, with no installation and nothing uploaded.

Open Slop Tables

How to do it

  1. Open Slop Tables and start typing, or pick a template.
  2. Write formulas with over 300 functions, and use several sheets in one workbook.
  3. Save the workbook to Slop Drive in this browser.
  4. Download XLSX or CSV to share it.

Your files stay on this device: Slop Tables runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is Slop Tables made by Microsoft?

No. Slopographic is not affiliated with Microsoft. Microsoft and Excel are trademarks of their owner, named here only to describe what people search for.

What is missing compared with a desktop spreadsheet?

Conditional formatting, sorting and filtering are not built yet, and charts are column, bar, line and pie only. It opens and saves XLSX, and has charts and pivot tables.

Does it save Excel files?

Yes. Download XLSX writes values, formulas, number formats, column widths, merges and frozen panes.

Do I need an account?

No. Your workbooks stay in this browser, and there is nothing to sign up for.
